uncertainty_note: Paired English review clusters move translations and all fitted seeds together. Intervals condition on these models. Seed sample SD is reported separately.
limitations: Historical test controls omit prompt text. Saved data, hashes and adapter identities are verified.
The intervention was developed using Food development evidence and then fixed for Phone.
Phone has no implicit gold targets. Food test has no empty-gold reviews.
Food and Phone use different evaluation cohorts. Their gain difference alone is not a causal test.
